name: storage-crit-fluss-disk-write-locked

query_condition.sql: SELECT body, log_file_name, host_name FROM "fluss_logs" WHERE str_match(body, 'data disk usage reached|DISK_WRITE_LOCKED')

description: CRITICAL storage: Fluss rejected writes - a backing data disk reached the 85% write limit ('data disk usage reached ...' / DISK_WRITE_LOCKED). Appends time out client-side (UNCERTAIN) and raw_table_1 log_end stops. The lock is sticky: while the process runs, writes resume only below the recover ratio (write-recover-ratio, 0.80 default); a tablet restart re-evaluates at the current usage. Recovery runbook: docs/06_operations/07-lake-archive-ops.md 'Recovery: Fluss write-locked'. Early warning: INFRA-crit-disk-20 (free <20%). Provisioned by seed_alerts.py from openobserve/alerts/storage-alerts.json.

name: storage-crit-ingestion-append-blocked

query_condition.sql: SELECT body, service_name FROM "platform_logs" WHERE str_match(body, 'DISK_WRITE_LOCKED|append UNCERTAIN')

description: CRITICAL storage: ingestion appends are failing in the client (DISK_WRITE_LOCKED / append UNCERTAIN, >=3 in 5m). Same cause and runbook as storage-crit-fluss-disk-write-locked: the Fluss data disk is at or over its write limit - free space below the recover ratio and confirm log_end advances. This is the ingestion-side net for the case where the tablet log line alone is missed.
